customManagers.description: Track pip pins in Dagster entrypoint script
Track Docker image tags in module definitions

Track the pinned image.tag registry default in modules/orchestration/dagster/module.yaml against the dagster PyPI version, since it must stay in sync with the dagster== pin in images/dagster/requirements.txt for `--image-source registry`/`cds config set image.source registry` to pull a valid published tag

Track the pinned image.tag registry default in modules/bi/superset/module.yaml against the apache/superset Docker tag, since it must stay in sync with the apache/superset base pinned in images/superset/base/Dockerfile for `--image-source registry`/`cds config set image.source registry` to pull a valid published tag
Keep the documented minimum Python version in docs/support-policy.md in sync with pyproject.toml's requires-python
Track the Trivy CLI version pinned via trivy-action's version: input, since the action's own bundled default (which Renovate cannot see) lags behind the latest Trivy release
Track exact-pinned CI-only tool versions installed via pip/npx in workflow run steps (not library dependencies, which intentionally use flexible ranges in pyproject.toml)
Track the exact-pinned renovate npm package version used to validate this file via `npx --package renovate@<version>`

packageRules.description: Do not update local development image tags
Only bump Python minimum version at cycle level (minor/major), not on patch releases — requires-python tracks supported cycles, not specific patches

Batch the self-pinned renovate npm package (used by renovate-config-validator in ci.yml) into a single weekly PR instead of one per upstream patch release -- renovate ships multiple patch releases per day, so without this each release reopens/edits a new PR the moment the previous one merges
